title: quiz_meta
description: One row per quiz: quiz-level metadata, branding, and prize. Source table data/tables/quiz_meta.csv. quiz_id is the primary key referenced by scoring.csv, details.csv, and quiz_structure.csv; supplies the `quiz_context` the enrichment template looks up per quiz. The `prize.*` columns together form the optional prize object (all blank when the quiz has no prize, e.g. prize_type 'none'). account_id allows for filtering by client environment/account scope.

account_id.description: Account this quiz belongs to, used for filtering values to a particular client's environment.

quiz_id.description: Primary key. Referenced by scoring.quiz_id, details.quiz_id, quiz_structure.quiz_id.

language.description: ISO 639-2/B three-letter language code of the quiz.

prize.prize_name.description: Name of the prize. Blank/empty when the quiz has no prize.

prize.prize_url.description: URL to the prize/promotion page. Blank/empty when absent.

prize.prize_value.description: Monetary value of the prize, in prize.prize_currency units. Blank/empty when there is no value.

prize.prize_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for prize.prize_value. Blank/empty when there is no monetary value.

prize.prize_description.description: Free-text description of the prize. Blank/empty when absent.

brand_tags.description: Brand/topic tags as a JSON-array string, e.g. '["sports","apparel"]'. Parse as JSON to get the list of tag strings.

prize_type.description: Prize category as a JSON-array string (typically one element), e.g. '["product"]'. The value '["none"]' marks a quiz with no prize. Observed elements: product, experience, subscription, gift-card, voucher, collectible, credit, ticket, none.
